items.title: Live: US-Iran ceasefire to include Lebanon as Trump says 'let the oil flow'
items.description: Pakistan, which has been negotiating peace talks between the US and Iran, says a deal to end the war has been agreed. Follow live.

items.title: Iran briefing: Before the ceasefire, Trump resumed dropping f-bombs
items.description: Donald Trump is reported to unleash another expletive-laden outburst at Benjamin Netanyahu over Israeli strikes as the US and Iran finalise a peace deal.

items.title: Outbreak of this Victorian-era disease labelled a 'health disaster and tragedy'
items.description: Forty-two babies in Australia died from congenital syphilis between 2011 and 2025, with the outbreak driving health workers into communities to raise awareness of the old-world disease.

items.title: 'Let them talk': Socceroos hero bites back at claim Türkiye 'dominated'
items.description: Socceroos goalscoring hero Nestory Irankunda says Türkiye could not back up their talk, despite one of its stars claiming post-game Australia had been "dominated".

items.title: Live: Feisty Côte d'Ivoire-Ecuador clash threatens to boil over
items.description: Côte d'Ivoire and Ecuador face off after Japan finds a late leveller against the Netherlands and World Cup debutant Curaçao enjoys a magical moment in the midst of a drubbing. Follow live.

items.title: Live: 'Chaotic weather' forecast for White House UFC event
items.description: As the fighters prepare for their South Lawn debuts, the Weather Channel is predicting heavy rain and potential thunderstorms. Follow live.

items.title: 'Absolutely terrified': Scolyer's doctor reveals fears of experimental therapy
items.description: Just 11 weeks before he died, Richard Scolyer cycled 500km in four days. In his last major TV interview, the celebrated pathologist tells Australian Story the secret to a fulfilling life and his doctor reveals the huge risks he took to try new brain cancer treatment.

items.title: Police treating deaths of man and girl at Sydney bay as murder-suicide
items.description: Investigators are trying to determine what led to a suspected murder-suicide on Saturday, after the bodies of a father and young child were recovered from a bay off Concord.

items.title: China's ability to hit Australia with missiles 'real and growing'
items.description: New analysis warns that China's military is developing a "real and growing" ability to hit the Australian mainland with missiles, and can already threaten Australia's trade routes, subsea cables and critical infrastructure.

items.title: Picturesque islands in WA's north set to become transport hubs after $20m sale
items.description: A Kimberley iron ore mine with idyllic views across a tropical sea will close after 70 years of operation as a new phase begins for offshore oil and gas.

items.title: Is SpaceX worth $3 trillion? Of course not, but that's not the point
items.description: To get a sense of the difference between the Tesla and SpaceX IPOs, consider that 1.7 billion seconds ago was 1972, when Elton John released Rocket Man, while 1.7 trillion seconds ago was 52,000BC, when we shared the planet with Neanderthals.

items.title: Ireland is a data centre 'cautionary tale'. This is the impact on locals
items.description: As Australia and other countries embark on a new wave of AI-driven data centre development, locals in Ireland share how the runaway growth of the facilities can affect everyday life.

items.title: 'I fear for my safety': Victim unable to break lease without paying
items.description: Annie feared for her safety from a new next-door neighbour in northern Tasmania, but was told she couldn't break her lease without continuing to pay rent. She was then sexually assaulted.

items.title: Multi-billion-dollar economic policy undermined by 'black cladding'
items.description: Almost $15 billion has been spent over a decade via the federal government's Indigenous Procurement Policy, but critics say it's failed to make a significant difference to Indigenous people due to the practice of "black cladding".

items.title: A lost Sam Pang went looking for something. He found comedy
items.description: This workplace satire starring Sam Pang has Tasmania's first ever AFL team firmly in its sights.

items.title: New doco details how Rolf Harris was able to hide his crimes
items.description: Plus Brisbane is a main character in a new rom-com, Russell T Davies delivers a devastating drama, and we bring you more shows lighting up TV this month.

items.title: History quiz: Test yourself on these past events
items.description: When was Salt Lake City awarded the XIX Winter Olympics? And how much do you know about the Fast and the Furious films? Test yourself in this week's history quiz.

items.title: Buyer's agency clients urged to proceed days before collapse
items.description: Emails and messages seen by ABC News show Dashdot's staff were still encouraging prospective customers to engage with the buyers agency shortly before it entered voluntary liquidation.

items.title: Prolonged pause on interest rates possible as RBA board meets for June
items.description: Most experts are tipping interest rates will remain on hold but the question is when will they come down.

items.title: Business groups urge rejection of CGT changes
items.description: Business groups are urging the government to scrap its capital gains tax changes as the first tranche of measures is scrutinised at a parliamentary inquiry.

items.title: Palestinians fear 'archaeology has become a tool' in Israel's plans for West Bank
items.description: Palestinians believe there is more to Israel's recently announced plans to develop heritage sites along the West Bank, arguing archaeology has "become a tool, a mechanism, to justify settlement and justify the displacement of Palestinians" across the area.

items.title: WA needle exchanges report 'astronomical' rise in peptide use
items.description: Needle exchanges in Western Australia are reporting dramatic increases in people accessing their services for peptide use.

items.title: Fraud claims and a $400k sculpture: What a secret RSL report found
items.description: The secret report details claims of the misappropriation of funds and fraud, including one of the NSW charity's sub-branches raising money for veterans from the Korean defence force.

items.title: Travellers owed $4.3 million as dream holidays shattered
items.description: Australian travellers who collectively lost millions after a travel agency collapsed are calling for an overhaul of consumer protections in the sector.

items.title: Twelve killed as skydiving plane goes down shortly after take-off
items.description: The private plane had just taken off and made a turn before it crashed and caught fire, authorities said.
